# Bailey & Omi — 2026 San Diego library submission sprint

**Prepared November 4, 2026 · S.T. Carroll · status: prepared, NOT submitted.** Do not edit published Book 1 files or claim acceptance, sales, rankings, reviews, or purchase availability.

## Time-sensitive: San Diego Public Library 61st Local Author Exhibit

**Registration plus receipt of one published print copy must be completed by Wednesday, November 25, 2026.** Primary sources:

- [Local Author Exhibit eligibility, delivery deadline, and FAQ](https://www.sandiego.gov/public-library/news-events/localauthors)
- [Official 2026 registration form](https://www.sandiego.gov/public-library/news-events/localauthorssubmit)

The program is open to current San Diego County residents with books published in 2026, including self-published titles. A successful submission is **not** a guaranteed sale, placement or future acquisition. The event's official page lists a 2027 opening/showcase and subsequent 12-month library circulation of qualifying submissions. Verify the current author residence and the publication date before submitting.

## Second channel: San Diego County Library's local-author donation review

- [County Library official instructions](https://www.sdcl.org/donations/)
- [Official two-page Local/Self-Published Author Donation Form](https://cdn-web-main.bibliocms.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/98/2025/04/SDCL_Local-Authors-Form.pdf)

Submit one finished physical book and the **official** form to a County Library branch or its headquarters at 5560 Overland Ave., Suite 110, San Diego, CA 92123, after confirming current local acceptance. Form requests title, author, genuine phone/email, desired return branch, speaking branch if applicable, and publication reviews **if any**. If there are no legitimate reviews, do not invent one. Donated book acceptance is discretionary and not a sale. The companion PDF pack is an author prep sheet, **not a replacement for the official County form**.

## Avoid low-probability / ineligible bookstore outreach

- [The Book Catapult's local author policy](https://thebookcatapult.com/local-authors): excludes books published by Amazon and requires Ingram returnability. It does not accept consignment or review samples.
- [Verbatim Books event policy](https://verbatimbooks.com/events/): says it does not host events for Amazon-published books and rarely hosts solo-author events.

Book 1 was self-published through KDP. Do **not** send generic pitches to these stores under existing distribution conditions; re-evaluate only if legitimate alternative print/distribution terms change.
